'''Olon Lono''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He assisted a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were about to fight in the [[Battle of Koseyet]].
